summary: Re-review of Phase 3 at 79f86404b. All four r1 findings are closed. The F1 fix covers the true gap of 6 test-bearing packages (r1 reported 4; the base fixture run and CI-R1 found the 2 services too). CI-R1 to CI-R3 fail on the pre-fix fixture with labeled reasons and pass at the head; the full scripts/ci gate reproduces at 133 of 133, exit 0, and the science gates at 40 of 40. The id guard accepts all 10 real table ids, and the workflow-level contents: read breaks no step. One Major finding stays: the plan 3.5 record that the architecture-enforcement suite holds 2 pre-existing failures does not reproduce at the audited head (251 of 251 pass in both runner contexts, the two named cases pass, and the phase range touches no input of the suite), and its citation points at a track that is absent from master. Review B F6 is confirmed by facts and stays with Review B and the PM decision.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Major] review-a: Plan task 3.5 records `the restored packages/architecture-enforcement suite holds 2 failures that predate this track (monorepo_boundaries_20261029 records them)` and `the packages job can show these 2 failures until the PM opens the D5 track`. Measured at the audited head 79f86404b: the suite holds 0 failures — 31 files, 251 tests, 251 passed, EXIT=0 in the root-config context, and the same 251 of 251, EXIT=0 from the package directory (the context that the CI `pnpm test --filter=@reading-advantage/architecture-enforcement...` turbo task runs); the two named base-failure cases (`architecture-reconciliation-cli.test.ts` `exercises repository discovery and the production default boundaries`, `archive-evidence-path-compatibility.test.ts` `restores every accepted active path with an immutable archive link`) pass 7 of 7. The phase range 25d774e08..79f86404b touches no input of the suite (empty diff over packages/architecture-enforcement, measure/archive, and test-fixtures). The citation `monorepo_boundaries_20261029` names no track directory under measure/tracks/ on master; it exists only on the unmerged branch chore/monorepo-boundaries, whose plan records the 2 failures as base failures measured in its own worktree. The plan copied the record without a run on master; the same unmeasured line sits in the Green r3 log. Rationale: plan evidence must hold measured facts, and this record misinforms the D5 follow-up and the phase acceptance. Fix: correct the plan line to the measured state (suite green at the audited head, both runner contexts) and cite the rerun or the chore/monorepo-boundaries branch as the source of the historical 2-failure record. The D5 note about the separate red `pnpm architecture:check` step on master stays true (plan 3.3).

F1 withdrawn: closed by Green r3. The `Test` step of the `packages` job (.github/workflows/ci.yml line 189 at 79f86404b) now holds 9 `--filter=<root>...` roots: the 3 non-table apps plus @reading-advantage/architecture-enforcement, knowledge-space-practice, mastery-runtime-compat, scripts, session-service, and worker. The r1 finding understated the gap: it covered only apps/ and packages/ and missed services/session-service and services/worker, so the true base gap was 6, not 4. The fix covers all 6, and CI-R1 reads the globs, so the class of miss cannot repeat. Proving test: CI-R1 (fails on base, passes on fix).

F2 withdrawn: closed. Plan 3.5 records `turbo_filters_ok=10` with the per-id package counts, re-measured by Green r3 (the F102, F104 remediation). Review A measured the same 10 in r1; this run did not re-measure it (the command was denied), and the label is present.

The 8 track commits are the routed Red (f00f28493 and e72e4b8ae test file; 825713559 and a0b5f7209 plan evidence) and Green (36b2b7bb9 ci.yml, e99512251 affected-apps.mjs, 049eef53f runbook, 79f86404b plan 3.5). The helpers of the test suite are unchanged in the range (empty diff over scripts/ci/__tests__/helpers).

Check 1 test meaning (A2, A3, A4): the remediation cases fail on the base and pass on the fix for the right reason. Base fixture: a git-archive copy of 57bb8376c at /tmp/opencode/r2-base-x, run through heavy-run with CICD_FIXTURE_ROOT and AFFECTED_APPS_SCRIPT pointing at the base tree (the helpers read the fixture through FIXTURE_ROOT and the script-path override, so the repository wrote nothing): 3 failed of 3. CI-R1 fails with `uncovered_test_packages=6 names=@reading-advantage/architecture-enforcement,@reading-advantage/knowledge-space-practice,@reading-advantage/mastery-runtime-compat,@reading-advantage/scripts,@reading-advantage/session-service,@reading-advantage/worker test_packages=47 filter_roots=13 workspace_globs=4`; CI-R2 fails with `unsafe id "x;rm -rf /": expected exit 2, got 0` (the base script has no id guard); CI-R3 fails with `ci.yml has no workflow-level permissions map; permissions=undefined`. At the audited head the same 3 cases pass inside the full gate. No vacuous pass: every case throws on a missing deliverable (workspace globs list, table, Test step, permissions map), CI-R1 requires every filter token to end with `...`, and the counts are labeled integers compared with `>=` floors and `=== 0`, not bare-digit matches (A3 clean).

Check 1 closure correctness: the CI-R1 computation is faithful. workspaceGlobs reads pnpm-workspace.yaml (4 globs, floor 4); packageFolders walks apps/*, packages/*, packages/integrations/*, services/*; visit() walks dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies, and optionalDependencies through the package-name map; the roots are the Test-step filter roots plus every table id, resolved by row id or package name, and every root must resolve or the case throws. Review A reproduced the same closure in an independent Python computation and got the same 47 test-bearing packages and the same empty uncovered set.

Check 2 one line and the science gates: the `Test` run line is one line in ci.yml (line 189), so the gate regex `run:[^\n]*pnpm test` matches. The science gates reproduce at 40 of 40, EXIT=0, under the recorded verification-config invocation. The plan claims no green CI: task 3.3 records the master run 41796713259 as failed at the `Architecture boundary check` step and states that CI is not green and not fixed by this track (D5). The plan's claim about 2 architecture-enforcement suite failures does not reproduce (F5).

Check 3 id guard and permissions: the SAFE_ID pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` accepts all 10 real ids of scripts/ci/apps.json (www-reading-advantage, primary-advantage, storytime, accounting, codecamp-advantage, marketing, sales-advantage, accounts, workbooks, reading-advantage); CI-R2 also asserts 0 rejected real ids and runs a control that the real table exits 0. The workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` breaks no step: the three jobs (select, packages, affected) use only checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v4, step outputs, service containers, and shell commands; no step writes a check, comment, release, or deployment status, and no job defines a job-level permissions map (CI-R3 checks all 3 jobs, `jobs_checked=3`).

Check 5 plan truth: the gate rerun reproduces the 3.5 evidence at the audited tree: 7 test files, 133 passed (133), failed 0, EXIT=0. The 3.5 labels verified here: test_packages=47, filter_roots=19 (9 run roots plus 10 table ids), workspace_globs=4, safe_table_rows=10, unsafe_ids_refused=3, ci_permissions={"contents":"read"} with jobs_checked=3. The lint gate `node --check scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs` follows strategy Q8; the Q8 premise holds (no eslint.config or .eslintrc at the repository root; the 44 configs found sit inside packages and apps).

Review B F6 confirmed (not re-audited; stays with Review B and the PM decision): the ci.yml `pull_request` paths list omits `scripts/**`, and no job of ci.yml runs scripts/ci/__tests__ (the packages job runs named vitest files under packages/ only, so the remediation tests run nowhere in CI). The PM decided to fix F6 in Phase 3 with a small Red/Green after this result.

A4/A5 sweep over the plan phase 3 text: every count in 3.1 to 3.5 carries a label; the only green claims are the scripts/ci suite and the science gates, both reproduced here at exit 0; no `PASS=N, FAIL=0` claim contradicts a test exit. One false record remains (F5).
